# Generic interface final fields

This independently authored interface has three closed generic final fields,
including a nested wildcard and a self nominal argument. Opaque raw providers
perform ordered callbacks and reenter the interface before and between stores.
Provider arguments use independent static reads, retaining their original read
events instead of requiring a stored-result register to supply another field.
Their returned carriers may be null, aliased, replaced or contain unchecked
values unrelated to the source type arguments.

The observer checks each trigger field and reflective access, partial writes,
exact callback failures, erroneous-class reuse and reads after initialization.
Source and dependency profiles compile every emitted Java8 unit and preserve
all original definitions, roles, metadata and Exceptions. Independent wrong
programs run before recovery; Signature-only controls preserve original Code.
